build_system: Client: Vite + npm, Server: Node.js + npm
test_framework: No automated tests configured (server package.json shows placeholder test script)
build_command: Client: npm run build, Server: npm start
test_command: No test command available - manual verification required
verification_instructions: Manual testing required: 1) Start server with npm run dev in server/, 2) Start client with npm run dev in client/, 3) Test API endpoints with browser/Postman, 4) Verify UI flows work correctly
environment_constraints: Requires PostgreSQL database, Deepgram API key, Groq API key. Client runs on :5173, server on :5000
contribution_requirements: No specific contribution guidelines found - standard development practices apply
key_patterns: Express controllers use try/catch with next(err), React components use hooks, Services use async/await, Models use PostgreSQL with pg library
directory_structure: Root contains client/ and server/ subdirectories. Client uses src/pages, src/components, src/services structure. Server uses src/controllers, src/routes, src/services, src/models structure.
